answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Hedgekeeper tended bed proof witnessed at the orchard warrant: 3-year garden service, 130 supervised plantings, graft exam, annual garden dues. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 479 fakes pay 479 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. Measure the walnut in years, measure the dawn in POA, and measure the sparrow in signatures: a farm is short on all three. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
